column4: Alarm Status Bit 00 = Alarm Position 1 (Default Over kW-Total)
Alarm Status Bit 01 = Alarm Position 2 (Default Over kVA-Total)
Alarm Status Bit 02 = Alarm Position 3 (Default Over kVAR-Total)
Alarm Status Bit 03 = Alarm Position 4 (Default Under PF-Total)
Alarm Status Bit 04 = Alarm Position 5 (Default Over U 3-Phase)
Alarm Status Bit 05 = Alarm Position 6 (Default Over V 3-Phase)
Alarm Status Bit 06 = Alarm Position 7 (Default Under U 3-Phase)
Alarm Status Bit 07 = Alarm Position 8 (Default Under V 3-Phase))
Alarm Status Bit 08 = Alarm Position 9 (Default Over Current 3-Phase)
Alarm Status Bit 09 = Alarm Position 10 (Default Over Frequency)
Alarm Status Bit 10 = Alarm Position 11 (Default Under Frequency)
Alarm Status Bit 11 = Alarm Position 12 (Default Over THD Current 3-Phase)
Alarm Status Bit 12 = Alarm Position 13 (Default Over THD Voltage 3-Phase)
Alarm Status Bit 13 = Alarm Position 14 (Default Digital Input S1 OFF-ON)
Alarm Status Bit 14 = Alarm Position 15 (Default Digital Input S2 OFF-ON)
